hook: Say ahhh and see the sound.
outcome: Inspect real frequency, amplitude, harmonics and vowel resonances with a live sound analyser.
sources: Peterson and Barney (1952), JASA 24:175-184, https://doi.org/10.1121/1.1906875. Nine sets of three vowel-formant averages. Factual numerical values only; no copyrighted prose or graphics reproduced.

W3C Web Audio specification, https://www.w3.org/TR/webaudio/. AnalyserNode FFT and Blackman window. W3C Software and Document licence (2023), https://www.w3.org/copyright/software-license-2023/. API used, prose not copied.
de Cheveigne and Kawahara (2002), YIN, https://doi.org/10.1121/1.1458024. Independently implemented algorithm, no third-party code copied.
Fletcher and Rossing, The Physics of Musical Instruments (1998). Harmonic principles; copyrighted reference, original illustrative synthesis recipes rather than a measured dataset.
UNSW Music Acoustics, https://phys.unsw.edu.au/music/clarinet/index.html. Clarinet harmonic principles, copyrighted reference; no excerpts or recordings copied.
Ladefoged and Johnson, A Course in Phonetics. Whisper and formant principles, copyrighted reference; no excerpts reproduced.
Jongman, Wayland and Wong (2000), JASA 108:1252. Sibilant spectral principle, copyrighted reference; no excerpts reproduced.

ISO 16:1975, https://www.iso.org/standard/3601.html. A4 = 440 Hz factual reference frequency only; equal-tempered note arithmetic independently implemented. Copyrighted publication, no excerpts reproduced.
Praat manual, https://praat.org/manual/Sound__To_Formant__burg____.html. LPC, pre-emphasis and speaker-dependent limitations. Copyrighted reference; no software or prose copied.

Numerical formants corroborated against Iseli, Shue and Alwan (2007), Table I, https://www.ee.ucla.edu/~spapl/paper/Iseli_JASA_07.pdf. Copyright ASA, no open reuse licence claimed. Facts checked only, no figures, prose or recordings bundled. All other papers/books cited above are copyrighted references with no open-content licence claimed; synthesis is original.
Original synthesized audio and signal-processing code: MIT. Original explanatory Manual: CC BY 4.0. No external audio, images, fonts, libraries or datasets bundled.
